message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters. Smaller text includes "EDISI 11-17 JUNI 2012," "INVESTIGASI," and the headline "SINDIKAT MANUSIA PERAHU" in bold blue letters. Other text at the top reads "NAMA-NAMA ANEH DAFTAR PEMILIH DKI," "DI BALIK KISRUH WAKIL MENTERI," and "PENGIJON PROYEK HAMBALANG." A barcode and pricing information are in the bottom left corner.

The main image shows a light-skinned man in a light-blue short-sleeved uniform shirt, dark trousers, and a blue garrison cap. He stands on a sandy beach, facing right. He holds a corner of the ocean’s surface like a piece of fabric, peeling it back to reveal two men’s faces submerged in the churning water underneath. The ocean features turquoise water with white foam and small waves. A small white boat sits on the horizon line under a clear blue sky. A red border runs along the left edge of the entire composition. The beach sand is tan and meets the white foam of the incoming tide.
